 N Corp. Courthouse
dataList.content:
N公司的法庭是一间完全雪白、被绝对寂静淹没的房间。
 N Corp.'s courtroom was a stark white chamber drowned in complete silence.

不愧是专为法律代表审判罪犯而建的地方，这座法庭气势恢宏、庄严肃穆……
 As expected of a place erected for representatives of the law to sit in judgment over criminals, the court of justice was imposing and majestic...

可正是这份恢宏，才让它显得格外空洞。
 Yet that very grandeur made it feel every bit as hollow.

dataList.place:
N公司法院 旁听席
 N Corp. Courthouse Public Gallery
dataList.content:
*叹气* 好吧，事已至此没法回头了。不如想想我们到底能做点什么。
 *sigh* Well, there's no turning back now. Might as well think about what we can actually do.

我们对默尔索在N公司的过去几乎一无所知……
 We know next to nothing about Meursault's past in N Corp....

所以我说我们得集中注意力，仔细听清庭审的每一句话。
 So I say we pay close attention and carefully listen to every word of the proceedings.

早该在那家伙被拖走之前逼问出点什么。那混蛋不追问根本不会开口。
 Should've pulled answers from the bloke before he got hauled off. The sod never says a word unless you question it out of him.

话是这么说，可我们哪知道他们会那么突然就把他带走啊？
 Sure, but how were we supposed to know they'd take him away so suddenly?
至少……我们可以有把握地假定，他的罪行并非触犯了N公司的那条禁忌。 At the very least... we may safely assume his crime was not a violation of the N Corp. Taboo.

没错……不然的话，打从我们认识他的第一天起，就该到处撞见N公司的禁忌猎人了。
 Right... Otherwise, we would've run into N Corp.'s Taboo Hunters left and right since the very first day we met him.

倘若时运相合，吾等或许还能得见身为N公司禁忌猎人的蜜黄标枪之姿……然而，惜哉……
 Had fortune aligned the hours, perchance we might have beheld the Yellow Harpoon in his Taboo Hunter days here in N Corp.... But alas...

是啊……然后被蜜黄标枪捅死无数次？
 Yeah... and get Yellow Harpooned to death more times than we can count?

听着罪人们的对话，我试图想象默尔索在N公司任职期间，究竟可能犯下了什么"罪行"。
 Listening to the Sinners' conversation, I tried to imagine what kind of "crime" Meursault could've committed during his time at N Corp.

我们所了解的默尔索……
 The Meursault we've known so far...
……可不是那种会无缘无故挑事、对别人动用暴力的人，不像我们当中的某些人。 ... isn't the sort to pick fights with or use violence against other people without justifiable reason, unlike some of us.

你那什么眼神，钟.头.？想打架吗？
 What're you givin' me that look for, C.H.? You lookin' for a fight?

没错，想打架吗，钟.头.？
 Yeah, lookin' for a fight, C.H?

等等，希斯克利夫……你也打算加入这个缩写游戏了？
 Wait, Heathcliff... have you decided to join in on the abbreviation game too?

啊，搞什么——真是被传染了，该死……！
 Ack, what the— It rubbed off on me, bloody hell...!

*吐了口烟* “钟.头.”纪元的到来，可真是又快又猛。
 *puff* The start of the C.H. era clocks hard.

他也不是那种会不顾后果、行为无常的人……
 Nor is he prone to erratic behavior with blatant disregard for possible consequences...

吾实难以想象，小默尔索竟会犯下需受审判之滔天恶行……！诚然，一旦领命，他惯于率先挥拳直击敌颜，甚至……呃，甚至在敌人紧攀其裤摆、涕泪求饶之际，仍执意卸其下颚……
 I loathe the notion that Young Meursault could have committed deeds so foul as to warrant a trial...! Though when given orders, he is wont to be the first fist to smite his foes upon their faces, and would fain dislocate their jaw even as, uh, even as they cling to the hem of his breeches, weeping for mercy...

嗯。上次行动中，我们这边人做的事情里，就他那手值得称赞。是种干净利落的制敌手段。
 Hm. Of all the actions taken by our men during the last operation, his alone merits compliment. It was an efficient method of neutralizing the enemy.

他也不是那种会怀恨在心的人……不像我认识的某个人……
 Nor is he the type to carry a grudge... like someone I know...

……抱歉，你们看我干什么？……哦。
 ... Sorry, why are you looking at me? ... Oh.

但丁，我几乎能看见你脑子里的齿轮在转，可乱猜现在也帮不上什么忙。
 Dante, I can almost see the gears turning in your head, but wild guesses won't get us anywhere right now.

你想想看，要是他的罪行普通到能被猜出来，也不至于落得永久流放这么极端的处置。所以我们别自己瞎琢磨了，坐下来专心听庭审吧。
 Think about it. If his crime were something normal enough to be guessable, then it wouldn't have resulted in a measure as drastic as permanent exile. So let's get out of our own heads, sit down, and focus on the proceedings.

<说得也是……>
 <That's true...>

话说，你刚才猜是什么把默尔索送上法庭的时候，在盯着我看，这事儿我还是挺在意的……算了，接下来我们专心听庭审就好。 You know what, it still bothers me that you were looking at me while trying to guess what could've sent Meursault to trial... Never mind. Let's just make sure to focus on the proceedings later.

……以实玛利长长地舒了口气，重新望向栏杆那头，看着众人为开庭做准备而忙碌起来。
 ... Ishmael let out a long breath and returned to watching the commotion past the bar as people prepared to begin the trial.

不过他确实有点不对劲。该怎么说呢……
 Something does feel off about him, though. How should I put this...

感觉他好像根本没和我们一起待在这法庭里似的。
 It's almost like he's not even present with the rest of us in this courtroom.

你说什么呢？默尔不就站在那儿吗。
 What are ya talkin' about? Meur's standing right over there.

呃，是啊，他是在那儿……
 Um, yes, he is...

可他给人的感觉离大家好远，就像他是来旁观别人的审判，而不是作为被告站在这儿……
 But he feels so distant from everyone, like he's here as a spectator to someone else's trial, not as the defendant...
就好像他的身体虽然站在这儿，目光却望向别的地方…… Like he's looking somewhere else even though his body is standing here...

<真的吗？那正常审判里，被告该是什么样子？>
 <Really? What's a defendant supposed to look like at a normal trial?>

正常审判是吧？给你说说：
 Normal trials, eh? Here's what:

挺胸抬头，凶巴巴地瞪着人，死死盯着法官，那眼神就跟在说"你他妈能拿我怎么样"似的。
 Chest puffed, eyes mad-doggin', starin' down the judge like you're sayin' "What're you gonna do about it, wanker?"

希斯克利夫，你这是在说亲身经历吗……？啊，算了，其实我也不太想知道……
 Are you speaking from experience, Heathcliff...? Oh, never mind, actually. I don't even want to know...

在短短一瞬间……
 For the briefest moment...

我感到无比孤独，仿佛与世上所有其他活着的灵魂都隔绝开来。
 I felt so alone, isolated from every other living soul in all the world.

我所做的每一件事，我当时深信是最好选择的每一个决定……
 Everything I'd done, every choice I'd made that I'd believed at the moment was for the best...
……都被无休无止地质问着。你真的确定那是最好的做法吗？你真能说那不是你一时武断的决定吗？ ... was questioned without end. Are you sure that was the best course of action? Can you truly say it wasn't an arbitrary decision on your part?

而在你不断为自己辩解的过程中，不知不觉地……
 And somewhere along the way, as you keep trying to justify yourself...

……你会发现，自己的决定早已化作后果，绕了回来，成了束缚你的枷锁。
 ... you realize that your decisions have come back around as consequences, as chains that bind you.

奥提斯压低声音，注视着法庭内部说道。
 Outis spoke in a low voice, gazing into the courtroom.

那你……你要怎么去面对这种事？
 How do you... How do you cope with something like that?

你不断地告诉自己，你是对的。一遍又一遍。
 You tell yourself that you were right. Over and over again.

你告诉自己别无选择。真的没有别的选择。如果必须，就欺骗自己吧。
 You tell yourself that you had no other choice. There was no other choice. Deceive yourself, if you must.

……这不过是一种权宜之计，为了让自己最终不至于弯腰屈服罢了。
 ... It's no more than a contrivance to keep oneself from stooping and succumbing in the end.

不过在这场审判中，我们更该关心的不是自我辩解，而是那个人在法官面前会如何应对。
 But in this trial, what we ought to be more concerned about is not self-justification, but how the man will carry himself before the judge.

你实际做过什么……其实没那么重要，重要的是你站在法官席前，能把它说得多有说服力、多有条理。
 What you actually have done... matters less than how convincingly and eloquently you can account for it when you're stood in front of the bench.

<*叹气* 可他连个替他做这些的律师都没有……>
 <*sigh* But he doesn't even have a lawyer to do that for him...>
